name: Model3DFormat
description: Represents the properties of a 3D model shape.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoFit
properties.description: Returns whether AutoFit is enabled for the model. Read/write.

properties.name: RotationX
properties.description: Returns the x-angle of a 3D model object's rotation. Read/write.

properties.name: RotationY
properties.description: Returns the y-angle of a 3D model object's rotation. Read/write.

properties.name: RotationZ
properties.description: Returns the z-angle of a 3D model object's rotation. Read/write.

properties.name: FieldOfView
properties.description: Returns the field-of-view angle of a 3D model object's camera, expressed in degrees. Read/write.

properties.name: CameraPositionX
properties.description: Returns the x-coordinate of a 3D model object's camera position. Read/write.

properties.name: CameraPositionY
properties.description: Returns the y-coordinate of a 3D model object's camera position. Read/write.

properties.name: CameraPositionZ
properties.description: Returns the z-coordinate of a 3D model object's camera position. Read/write.

properties.name: LookAtPointX
properties.description: Returns the x-coordinate of a 3D model object's camera look-at position. Read/write.

properties.name: LookAtPointY
properties.description: Returns the y-coordinate of a 3D model object's camera look-at position. Read/write.

properties.name: LookAtPointZ
properties.description: Returns the z-coordinate of a 3D model object's camera look-at position. Read/write.

methods.name: ResetModel
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the x-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: ResetSize
parameters.description: True to reset the 3D model frame to the same size as when a model is first inserted; False to leave the 3D model frame size alone.

methods.name: IncrementRotationX
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the x-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the model around the x-axis is to be changed. Any value can be provided, although any value will be effectively normalized into the range 0..360 degrees.

methods.name: IncrementRotationY
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the y-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the model around the y-axis is to be changed. Any value can be provided, although any value will be effectively normalized into the range 0..360 degrees.

methods.name: IncrementRotationZ
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the z-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the model around the z-axis is to be changed. Any value can be provided, although any value will be effectively normalized into the range 0..360 degrees.
